votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of May 2, 2023 and May 16, 2023.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from its May 2, 2023 and May 16, 2023 sessions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2023 Releasing Funding for the Affordable Housing Initiative – Perpetual Housing Fund Follow-up.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving the Term Sheet and Waiver of the Sustainable Development Policy for The Perpetual Housing Fund of Utah, LLC, releasing $10 million in ARPA dollars for the 515 Project affordable housing initiative.

votes.motion: Reconsider the motion from July 11, 2023, adopting the resolution amending the terms for the loan to Ville 1659 and clarifying the Housing Development Loan Program, 2023.
votes.description: The Board voted to reconsider its prior July 11, 2023 vote that approved modifications to the Ville 1659 Housing Development Loan Program loan terms, including changes to loan type, term length, and interest rate.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and for attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters in accordance with the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Board voted to end the closed session that had been held to discuss real property and attorney-client matters.
